title: closure-2-monad
description: The 2-functor Cl on the 2-category of predication-fibrations, given fiberwise by a C-natural closure-operator family and equipped with unit and multiplication; the 2-categorical promotion of the closure-operator that drives settling as its inferential engine.

endofunctor.description: Cl: PrFib(L, C, E) -> PrFib(L, C, E), defined fiberwise by Cl(E)_q := cl_q(E_q)

unit.description: eta: 1 => Cl, inclusion-into-closure, witnessing inflationarity v <=_k cl_q(v) at each fiber value

multiplication.description: mu: Cl^2 => Cl, nested-closure collapse; identity in the strict case, a canonical coherence 2-cell in the lax case

inflationary.description: the unit eta of the 2-monad: cl always extends its argument

lax-idempotent.description: mu -| eta_Cl with identity counit (Kelly-Lack K1): Cl is a Kock-Zoeberlein monad; reduces to strict idempotence under Scott-continuity

c-natural.description: Cl commutes with reindexing along predicate-category morphisms
